name: com.miui.zeus.mimo.sdk.ad.reward.RewardVideoAdActivity
sdkName: Xiaomi Mobile Ads Alliance (Mimo Ad SDK)
description: When the Xiaomi MiMo ads SDK is asked to show a rewarded video, this screen plays the ad and reports completion and reward callbacks.
disableEffect: Rewarded videos will not open, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.
